```python
    for row in table.select('tr'):
        cols = [c.get_text(strip=True) for c in row.select('td')]
        if len(cols) >= 2:
            t, v = cols[0], cols[1]
            try:
                avg[t] = float(v)
            except:
                pass

if not avg:
    # Fallback: search for labeled spans
    labels = soup.select('div.summary span')
    for sp in labels:
        text = sp.get_text(separator=' ', strip=True)
        # e.g., "Hotels: 3.6", "Motels: 3.9"
        if ':' in text:
            k,v = text.split(':',1)
            k=k.strip(); v=v.strip()
            try:
                avg[k] = float(v)
            except:
                pass

print("Parsed averages:", avg)
```

```python
# filename: quick_pdf_text_check.py
import re
from PyPDF2 import PdfReader

pdf_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/67e8878b-5cef-4375-804e-e6291fdbe78a.pdf"
reader = PdfReader(pdf_path)
text = "\n".join(page.extract_text() or '' for page in reader.pages)

# Very lightweight parse: find blocks following section headers
def collect_ratings(section_name):
    # Find section block starting at header
    pattern = section_name + r"[\s\S]{0,500}"
    blocks = re.findall(pattern, text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    ratings = []
    for blk in blocks:
        # Match float-like numbers 0-5 near names (naive)
        for m in re.finditer(r"(\b[0-5](?:\.0)?\b)", blk):
            try:
                val = float(m.group(1))
                ratings.append(val)
            except:
                pass
    return ratings

hotels_r = collect_ratings("Hotels")
motels_r = collect_ratings("Motels")

print("Hotels ratings (sampled):", hotels_r[:10])
print("Motels ratings (sampled):", motels_r[:10])
print("Counts:", len(hotels_r), len(motels_r))
```
